rows.en: <operator(23310,1)><speed(2)>Dr. <color(5)>Saotome<ce()> built <color(5)>Shin Dragon<ce()> to destroy the Earth.
<operator(23310,1)><speed(2)>That must be what came of him wrestling with the Ageha Plan in his own way.
<operator(23310,1)><speed(2)>I'd like to bring the truth of that to light in this battle.
<operator(19050,1)><speed(2)>If there's real intent behind his goal, was it really that heavy a burden?
<operator(19060,1)><speed(2)>We're about to go find that out.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Faye<ce()>... I wonder if <color(5)>Berkt<ce()> will be there.
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)>As long as he hasn't finished what he set out to do, he'll show up here for sure.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>...Let's make this the last one.
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)>Yeah.
<operator(1040,2)><speed(2)>Getting this far is thanks to you too, <color(4)>Faye<ce()>. Thank you.
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)>What, all of a sudden?
<operator(1040,2)><speed(2)>No, I only wanted to say it... Even if I was a lousy student.
<operator(1060,2)><speed(2)>That's not true. I'm the one who... learned something.
<operator(23010,1)><speed(2)>The <color(5)>Invaders<ce()> and the Scub Coral... maybe <color(4)>Nirvash<ce()> is tied up in that too.
<operator(23030,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Nirvash<ce()> chose you two. If it's tied to the <color(5)>Invaders<ce()>, maybe it's pushing you to act.
<operator(23020,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Nirvash<ce()> doesn't say anything. But I understand. It entrusted the future to <color(4)>Renton<ce()> and me.
<operator(23010,1)><speed(2)>Yeah... let's give it our all. <color(4)>Eureka<ce()>!
<operator(21030,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Gainer<ce()>, <color(4)>Gain<ce()>, please be careful out there.
<operator(21010,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Sara<ce()>... are you worried about me?
rows.notes: Pronoun ambiguous (singular/plural); kept as 'me' since Sara's reply broadens it to everyone.

rows.en: <operator(21030,1)><speed(2)>Of course I am! Everyone... I mean... because we're comrades!
<operator(19020,1)><speed(2)>So basically, we go find out from <color(5)>Saotome<ce()> himself.
<operator(19020,1)><speed(2)>I don't know what <color(5)>Saotome<ce()>'s after. But... because of him, we spent years stuck living in dark shelters.
<operator(19030,1)><speed(2)>But that's over now. We leave the past behind, here and now.
<operator(19010,1)><speed(2)>Yeah... let's go, both of you.
<operator(19050,1)><speed(2)>We fought that war on the moon believing in peace, and here we are now.
rows.notes: 'moon war' here (getsumen sensou) is not the locked 'Moon Invader War' compound; left as a plain description since the source string differs.

rows.en: <operator(19060,1)><speed(2)>I still can't fully turn my back on Dr. <color(5)>Saotome<ce()>. He made Getter for peace. For that man to become mankind's enemy...
<operator(19040,1)><speed(2)>Back in those days, the old man was always a kind soul who thought of peace...
<operator(19040,1)><speed(2)>But that old man <color(5)>Saotome<ce()> sent my life badly off course...
<operator(19060,1)><speed(2)>No... maybe it's everyone's life who's ever been tied to Getter...
<operator(19050,1)><speed(2)>This time, we take down <color(5)>Shin Dragon<ce()> for good. I'm counting on you... <color(4)>Ryoma<ce()>.
<operator(19040,1)><speed(2)>Yeah, I'm off. Old man, I'll pay you back in full!
<operator(16040,1)><speed(2)>So things like that exist in the surface world... That power will destroy everything, won't it?
<operator(16040,1)><speed(2)>If it comes to that, will Byston Well be destroyed too?
<operator(16010,1)><speed(2)>I don't know about that... But I want to protect my mom and dad too. So... I'll fight, and I'll prove it.
<operator(12121,1)><speed(2)>Who'd have thought I'd end up fighting for some grand cause like saving the world.
<operator(12011,1)><speed(2)>Cause, ideology, none of that matters. Get rid of the crisis. That's it.
<operator(12121,1)><speed(2)>Heh... true enough. All that's left is to put my strength to use for the result.

uncertainties.issue: Gainer's '心配してくれるの？' has no stated object; kept as 'me' since it reads as him assuming Sara meant only him, and her next line broadens it to 'everyone' as a light correction.
'月面戦争' (moon war) in Hayato's line is not the same string as the locked 'Moon Invader War' (月面インベーダー戦争); rendered as a plain lower-case description rather than assuming they're the same event/term.

meaning_fixes.before: No, I just wanted to say it... Even if I was a lousy student.
meaning_fixes.after: No, I only wanted to say it... Even if I was a lousy student.
meaning_fixes.reason: Lowercase 'j' has no native glyph in the game font; reworded ('only' for 'just') without changing meaning.

checked_decisions: Speakers resolved: 23310 Greg Egan ('Bear') on Dr. Saotome/Shin Dragon; 19050 Hayato Jin, 19060 Benkei Kuruma, 19040 Ryoma Nagare, 19030 Gai, 19020 Kei, 19010 Go (Getter Robo cast); 1040/1060 Barrel/Faye; 23010/23020/23030 Renton/Eureka/Holland; 21030/21010 Sara/Gainer; 16040/16010 Luxe/Asap; 12121/12011 Tsukiomi/Akito.
Slot 20 (table 0): 'Ageha Plan' matches the encyclopedia_022/021_b lock.

Table 1 slot 100: Gainer's '心配してくれるの？' has no stated object; 'me' is a safe reading since he is asking about himself and Sara's reply broadens it to 'everyone'. No addressee/subject invented beyond what the exchange settles. Accepted.

Table 1 slot 179: '月面戦争' (a plain 'war on the moon') is a different source string from the locked 'Moon Invader War' (月面インベーダー戦争); keeping it as a lower-case generic description rather than substituting the locked compound is correct - they are not the same term in this line. Accepted.
Table 1 slots 99-101: '-kun'/'-san' dropped on Gainer/Gain, consistent with established corpus practice.

No mistranslations, reversed meanings, wrong addressees, invented subjects, or misplaced commands found in the remaining rows; all <operator>/<speed>/<color> tags match the source in content and order.
remaining_uncertainties: Table 1 slot 100: whether Gainer's 'are you worried about me?' should stay singular or already imply the group is not fully settled by the source; kept singular per the immediate context.
